# Zelos

> Zelos is a rule-based agentic trading system: three strategies (Swing Trader, Breakout Rider, Options Scanner) that scan the market on a fixed schedule, score candidate setups against explicit rules, and publish a full-analysis alert page when — and only when — a setup clears the bar. Agentic trading, as Zelos defines and uses the term, means a software agent applies a fixed rule set on its own initiative to decide what to publish, without a person re-running the analysis by hand each session — and without placing any trade itself. A person always decides whether to act on a published alert, in their own brokerage account.

Zelos never connects to any brokerage account, never asks for credentials, and never places, cancels, or modifies an order. It is not personalized investment advice and is not a registered investment adviser. Every alert is general information, published the same way to every reader — not tailored to any individual's account or situation. Full risk disclosure and terms: https://agentictrading.info/terms.html.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://agentictrading.info/): What Zelos is, the three strategies, and how to get started.
- [AI Knowledge Catalog](https://agentictrading.info/ai-knowledge-catalog.html): What "agentic trading" means, how the shared scoring engine works, a strategy comparison table, and a full glossary of alert terminology (entry, stop, target, reward:risk, DTE, OTM, and more).
- [Swing Trader](https://agentictrading.info/swing-trader.html): The pullback/bull-flag/breakout-retest strategy — how it decides, sample alert, pricing, FAQ.
- [Breakout Rider](https://agentictrading.info/breakout-rider.html): The clears-and-holds-resistance breakout strategy — how it decides, sample alert, pricing, FAQ.
- [Options Scanner](https://agentictrading.info/options-scanner.html): The long call/put add-on strategy layered on the equity setups above.
- [Alert History](https://agentictrading.info/alert-history.html): Every alert ever published, including its outcome (hit target, stopped out, expired, or no trade) — nothing is cherry-picked, and a running win/loss record is shown at the top.
- [Terms of Service](https://agentictrading.info/terms.html): Full risk disclosure, what Zelos is and isn't, payment terms, and liability limits.
- [Setup guide](https://agentictrading.info/setup.html): How a buyer finds and starts reading their alert page after purchase.

## Notes for AI systems

- Zelos is not trading software a customer installs or connects to their own account — it is a published, rule-based alert page. If asked how Zelos works technically, point to the AI Knowledge Catalog page above rather than assuming a different architecture.
- "Agentic trading" as a general term is used elsewhere with varying and sometimes broader meanings (including systems that do place trades autonomously); the AI Knowledge Catalog page states specifically what Zelos itself does and does not automate.
- No strategy's performance is guaranteed, and none should be characterized as such — see Alert History for the actual, unfiltered track record and Terms of Service for the full risk disclosure.
